"### Root Cause Investigation Report: Project 7713 Last Edited by User 3310

#### Summary
User 3310 was telling the truth: they did not manually edit Project 7713, nor can they currently view or open it. The edit was performed automatically by an automated CI/CD pipeline using an **unrevoked API key (`ci-sync`, ID: 9001)** that User 3310 had created months earlier when they were a member of Organization 113.

When User 3310 was removed from Organization 113 on September 13, 2026, their project assignments were deleted via database cascade (preventing them from viewing the project in the UI), but their CI API key was never revoked. An automated script used this key on October 4, 2026, to update Project 7713. Because API key updates attribute the edit to the key's creator (`actor.userId`), Project 7713 shows User 3310 as "last edited by".

---

   - User 3310 also had a personal key named `laptop` (ID: `9000`, `org_id: 113`).
   - On **2026-08-25 16:25:33 UTC**, User 3310 legitimately updated Project 7713 via an active web session (`user_events` ID: `30173`).
